v6VersionType: Android uses numeric 6, Web retains string 6
ciphertextAndSignature: EncryptionHelper.encryptAuth and signRsa both emit Base64.DEFAULT with 76-column LF and final LF; RSA-SHA256 signs the exact wrapped ciphertext bytes, not an unwrapped re-encoding
publicKeySerialization: SPKI DER Base64.DEFAULT (76 columns, LF including final LF); BEGIN PUBLIC KEY plus CRLF, wrapped DER, END PUBLIC KEY without final LF; UTF8 Base64.DEFAULT then one encodeChars transform
intentionalDifferences: RSA remains at least 2048 bits instead of the observed legacy 1024-bit generator
Device model and system version truthfully identify the desktop laboratory
No advertising identifier or Firebase token is invented
sessionPolicy: New login in an empty slot only; default and legacy Web sessions remain Web, and retain their original RSA/device identity
validation: Offline encrypted login, registration, retained restoration, call/privacy profile binding and fixed independent public-key byte fixture
liveLoginScope: Two distinct real accounts in the isolated Android-profile laboratory; both self identities confirmed and records sealed
restoreScope: Both saved Android-profile accounts restored with authenticated self reads, without OTP or another device registration
liveRequestCallOutcome: invalid_call_response; malformed response structure requires diagnosis before any further call attempt
privacy: No account data, private keys, OTPs or real session material
